name: Zealot
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee Infantry (Two-Handed Hammer) · special · 235 leadership · Seasonal (S24: Crown and Cross)

origin.text: Seasonal Unit · Crown and Cross (Season 24, Heroic Era)

pitch: A transformation-based shock hammer that crushes shield units and blob formations with knockdown while alive; activating Judgment Day mid-fight is its death sentence — heal and return, never transform under pressure. Strong against heavy-armored and fire-weak targets, it collapses against high-burst claymores and Yorkists.

doctrines.effect: Increases DMG dealt to units by 120, increases all types of DMG by 80.

battleRole.positioning: Stay close enough to engage with Righteous Charge (press 1 from range, or dash from melee). X-move near fights and let enemies aggro rather than pressing V immediately — the passive Malice (counts artillery, hero kills, and incoming hits) builds faster if they come to you. {1}
battleRole.tips: Never transform mid-fight. {1} Activate Judgment Day (press 3) only outside combat to heal and reposition — the transformation locks you immobile and vulnerable, and the animation can't be cancelled once started. {1} Righteous Charge (1) knocks down or dashes; Zeal Whirlwind (2) slams close-range. In Inquisitor form, press 1 becomes Dies irae (partial vacuum). {1} Malice passive counts kills AND damage-taken (any amount), not just kills — test in custom vs AI to see the difference. {1} Scorpio fire enrage applied before a fight stays until end of game, even after unit swap or death. {1}

cards.name: Symmachean Paladins
cards.why: house players run Zealots alongside Paladins in sieges — block-breaking support unlocked one fight from 70 to 200 unit kills

matchups.pressure: You pressure: shield units (CC + tanking knocks them down) and fire-weak units (big blob impact when enraged). {1}

controls.notes: Righteous Charge (1) — knockdown or dash depending on range; queue skill 2 while charging. {1} Zeal Whirlwind (2) — close-range slam; in Inquisitor form, dies irae becomes a partial vacuum pull. {1} Judgment Day (3) — transformation (immobilized during animation); only activate outside fights. {1} X-move + aggro-bait better than V-spam — Malice passive counts incoming damage. {1}

'Zealot' has no exact match in the unit list per two independent house guides - flagged as a possible identification gap, though a real in-game unit variant ('Zealot - Accursed') is confirmed via replay footage.

Replay analysis describes the 'Zealot - Accursed' variant as visually carrying 'polearm-style weapons', conflicting with the Two-Handed Hammer identity from Amya's guide - unreconciled; possibly a cosmetic skin or a visual misread. {5}
